labelMethod: Authored standalone functions, source-reviewed before inference. Each query has exactly the listed relevant source path; all other corpus functions are labelled irrelevant. Empty results score precision zero and miss. This controlled sample is not a full repository census.

samples.query: Compute the total of numeric list elements, starting at zero.
samples.source: export function f01(xs: number[]) { let n = 0; for (const x of xs) n += x; return n; }

samples.query: Find the largest numeric member of a sequence; empty gives negative infinity.
samples.source: export function f02(xs: number[]) { let n = -Infinity; for (const x of xs) if (x > n) n = x; return n; }

samples.query: Reverse the order of characters in a string.
samples.source: export function f03(s: string) { return [...s].reverse().join(''); }

samples.query: Remove repeated string entries while preserving first occurrence order.
samples.source: export function f04(xs: string[]) { return Array.from(new Set(xs)); }

samples.query: Restrict a number to a lower and upper bound.
samples.source: export function f05(x: number, lo: number, hi: number) { return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x)); }

samples.query: Calculate the product of positive integers from one through n.
samples.source: export function f06(n: number) { let p = 1; for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) p *= i; return p; }

samples.query: Extract the host portion after the final at sign in an email address.
samples.source: export function f07(s: string) { const i = s.lastIndexOf('@'); return i < 0 ? null : s.slice(i + 1); }

samples.query: Convert integer minor currency units into a two decimal places string.
samples.source: export function f08(n: number) { return (n / 100).toFixed(2); }

samples.query: Create a lowercase URL identifier by replacing non alphanumeric spans with hyphens and trimming edge hyphens.
samples.source: export function f09(s: string) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, ''); }

samples.query: Partition a list into consecutive fixed size groups; reject nonpositive sizes.
samples.source: export function f10<T>(xs: T[], n: number) { if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new Error('size'); const ys: T[][] = []; for (let i = 0; i < xs.length; i += n) ys.push(xs.slice(i, i+n)); return ys; }

samples.query: Determine whether an integer is divisible by two.
samples.source: export function f11(n: number) { return n % 2 === 0; }

samples.query: Flatten nested arrays by exactly one level.
samples.source: export function f12<T>(xs: T[][]) { return xs.flat(); }

samples.query: Compute the arithmetic mean of numeric values, returning null for an empty list.
samples.source: export function f13(xs: number[]) { if (!xs.length) return null; return xs.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / xs.length; }

samples.query: Return the first element of a sequence or undefined if empty.
samples.source: export function f14<T>(xs: T[]) { return xs[0]; }

samples.query: Return all list entries except the first one without mutating the input.
samples.source: export function f15<T>(xs: T[]) { return xs.slice(1); }

samples.query: Count how many values are truthy under JavaScript Boolean coercion.
samples.source: export function f16(xs: unknown[]) { return xs.filter(Boolean).length; }

samples.query: Deserialize JSON text, returning a caller supplied fallback on invalid syntax.
samples.source: export function f17(s: string, fallback: unknown) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { return fallback; } }

samples.query: Encode a UTF8 string as base64 text.
samples.source: export function f18(s: string) { return Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('base64'); }

samples.query: Escape HTML special characters ampersand and angle brackets.
samples.source: export function f19(s: string) { return s.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>'); }

samples.query: Sort numeric values ascending using a fresh array without modifying the original.
samples.source: export function f20(xs: number[]) { return [...xs].sort((a,b) => a-b); }

judgePairs.rightSource: export function alternative(values: number[]) { return values.reduce((acc, value) => acc + value, 0); }
export function alternative(values: number[]) { return values.reduce((acc, value) => acc * value, 1); }
declare function remote(values: number[]): number; export function alternative(values: number[]) { return remote(values); }
